use default

gnome_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let at mut = 0

    while at < values.count do
        if at == 0 \/ values[at] >= values[at - 1] then
            at = at + 1
        else
            (values[at], values[at - 1]) = (values[at - 1], values[at])

            at = at - 1
        fi
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

gnome_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))
